title: Zehra ka dulara pyaasa hai
body:
roti hai zameen e karbobala
sehraab hai saari khalqe khuda
zehra ka dulaara pyaasa hai
hai daagh uthaya akber ka
<<DIVIDER>>
asgher ka lahu hai mu pe mala
dil hogaya chhalni sarwar ka
pamaal huwa qasim dulha
mehraab o mimber rote hain
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra o hyder rote hain
daswi ko payambar rote hai'n
ham kyu'n na bahaye'n ashk bhala
zehra ki kamayi lut-ti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ahmed ki nishani mit-ti hai
sarwar ki ragejaa'n kat-ti hai
khanjar ke tale hai khushk gala
zakhmi huwe gham se qalb o jigar
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ka hai ye dil pe asar
sheh rote hai'n apni thaame kamar
dil par hai qayamat ka sadma
jab shimr ne khanjar pheyr diya
<<DIVIDER>>
sajde me namazi qatl huwa
pyaasahi raha ibne zehra
afsos kisi ne ye na kaha
zehra o ali ke jaani ko
<<DIVIDER>>
bejurm nabi ke sani ko
tarsate the zalim paani ko
jalti thi zameen e karbobala
karbal me qayamat aayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khaime me tadapti jaayi hai
marne ke kharee'n jo bhai hai
aflaak ke lab par hai nouha
